parsed.reason: All facts are conveyed accurately in Arabic: the intro is closed after the earlier no, saying yes now doesn't reopen it, other intros are still wanted, and Hale will text when it finds a match. No invented promises, apologies, or details. The register is somewhat stiff and formal (هذا التعارف بالذات انتهى… لا يمكن إعادة فتحه), and it shifts oddly between referring to Hale in the third person and using first person (سأراسلك), so it reads a bit less like a friend texting. Still clear and polite, but not fully warm and plain.
